blocks.text: New supporting character for the Era Zero song cycle.

Pelli is a young DBA person studying at the Central House of Meaning in Era Zero. A small articulated body helps them keep a steady pulse, but learning to listen while performing still takes practice.

They make A Shared Question with two unnamed classmates. Pelli contributes a clear, ringing lead; both classmates carry meaningful vocal parts. The work begins as an after-class exercise and remains a favorite among a small circle.
Pelli is not established as one of Talar’s Era One students or as a member of the Full Speakers. The later fate of their practice group is left open.
